"use client";

import { Button, QrCode, Stack } from "@chakra-ui/react"

export const QrCodeExplorerDemo = () => {
  return (
    <Stack gap="6" maxW="sm" align="center">
      <QrCode.Root value="https://www.google.com">
        <QrCode.Frame>
          <QrCode.Pattern />
        </QrCode.Frame>

        <QrCode.DownloadTrigger
          mt={4}
          asChild
          mimeType="image/png"
          fileName="qr-code.png"
        >
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
            Download QR
          </Button>
        </QrCode.DownloadTrigger>
      </QrCode.Root>
    </Stack>
  )
}

"use client";

import { Button, QrCode } from "@chakra-ui/react"

export const QrCodeWithExportWithLogo = () => {
  return (
    <QrCode.Root value="https://www.google.com">
      <QrCode.Frame>
        <QrCode.Pattern />
        <foreignObject x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%">
          <QrCode.Overlay
            style={{
              width: "33%",
              height: "33%",
              padding: "8px",
              background: "white",
            }}
          >
            <Logo />
          </QrCode.Overlay>
        </foreignObject>
      </QrCode.Frame>

      <QrCode.DownloadTrigger
        fileName="qr-code-with-logo.png"
        mimeType="image/png"
        asChild
      >
        <Button variant="outline" size="xs" mt="3">
          Download

      </QrCode.DownloadTrigger>
    </QrCode.Root>
  )
}

- Complete MIT examples with a ChakraProvider using defaultSystem.
- Reuse the application-level ChakraProvider when integrating; keep HiddenInput in checkbox and switch compositions for keyboard and form semantics.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
